sources.title: SargeDev/Solar-Decision-JEV-27B-V3-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Solar-Decision-JEV-27B-V3-GGUF The V3 solar run: combined corpus + r32 geometry + lm_head readout. huihui Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated + our solar LoRA (r32/α64) trained on the union of jev-distill-corpus-v3 + solar-decisions-corpus-v4 (764,626 rows, 90 domains) with lm_head added to the target modules, merged at step 2184.

sources.title: SargeDev/JEV-27B-Uncensored-GGUF - abliteration.org
sources.snippet: Fine-tuned on AutoTrust's JEV-27B System-1 decision block, merged into huihui-ai's abliterated Qwen3.8-27B backbone. The GGUF quant's imatrix additionally sampled 384 prompts from SargeDev/solar-decisions-corpus-v4.

sources.title: AutoTrust AI Releases JEV-27B, an Open Decision Model for Self-Hosted ...
sources.snippet: JEV-27B was trained on SargeDev/jev-distill-corpus-v3, a public, Apache-2.0-licensed corpus of Jev 1.13's outputs. It shares no weights or code with, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by, TypeSafe AI.
